# Bundled sample — SYNTHETIC DATA

**These files are not real FIRMS observations.** They are generated by
`scripts/make_sample.py` (fixed seed) and only imitate the FIRMS CSV column layout, so the
pipeline, tests and demo work offline without a MAP_KEY.

- Region: `sample_tocantins` (bbox -49,-11,-47,-9).
- Products: MODIS_SP (2003–2025), VIIRS_SNPP_SP (2012-01-20–2025), VIIRS_NOAA20_SP (2020–2025),
  and 10 days of MODIS_NRT / VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT / VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT (2026-11-04 → 2026-11-13).
- Known ground truth: per latent fire event, detection probability MODIS Terra 0.30, Aqua 0.35,
  VIIRS 0.85 per satellite. VIIRS therefore sees more fire-cell-days than MODIS, which is the
  gap the harmonization step has to correct.
- A persistent static heat source (`type=2`) near (-48.3, -10.2) tests the static-source filter.

Never present numbers or charts made from this sample as real fire activity.
